events.name: The Mirror Lake
events.intro:
*A lake so still it looks painted. You lean over the edge, and your reflection leans over to meet you. It is a half second late.*

You wave. The reflection waves back, after you have stopped. Then it does not stop waving.

*The water shivers. Shapes climb out of it, dripping nothing: the team from the fight you would rather forget.*

success.text: Your own team stands on the shore, exactly as it stood that day. They have the same moves. They know how you play.
You pick up a flat stone and send it skipping. The ripples run out and break them up, one by one, until only one is left. It sits on the bank, and watches you.
You step back from the edge. Nothing follows you. Behind you, the water settles, and goes on being painted.

events.name: The Mirror Lake: The Bow
events.intro:
The last reflection falls. They look at you for a moment, and at your team. Nobody says anything.

Then they bow, all of them, together, the way you wish you had that day.

*They turn and walk back into the water, and the water closes over them without a ripple.*

success.text: Where they went in, something is floating on the surface, bright as a coin. You lift it out. It is a small pane of glass, still cold, and it shows your team as it was. Nothing is taken.

effects.text: Beat my own team at the Mirror Lake.

events.name: The Mirror Lake: Back In
events.intro:
They stand over your team for a long moment, and do not press it. They look almost sorry.

Then they turn, and walk back into the lake, the way they came. They go in anyway.

*Nothing is taken. Your team gets up, a little dazed, to a lake gone perfectly still again.*

success.text: The water closes over the last of them. Your own face looks up from it, a half second late, and for once you cannot tell which of you looks more tired.

events.name: The Mirror Lake: A Half Second Late
events.intro:
*Another still water. You lean over it, and look at your own reflection.*

It is half a second late. It has the same face, and it is watching you with the same patience as the one on the bank.

success.text: You wave. The reflection waves, after you have stopped. Then, very slightly, it nods. You wave goodbye. Its hand comes up a half second later.
You walk on. Behind you, the water holds its breath. You do not look back, and you know it is still looking.
